messages:
anya-sales: NordBank POC kickoff — they require EU-only data residency, BYOK (HSM) and explicit no-US-subprocessors clause. Need quick confirmation on: routing pin options, canonical sub-processor list scoped to EU, and pricing delta for Dedicated+HSM vs Hosted+BYOK.

marta-presales: Noted. Do they want Private (VPC/on‑prem) or Dedicated reserved GPU? that changes the pricing materially.

tj-eng: We can tenant-pin to eu-west-1 for Private deployments. Hosted API has geo-failover by default unless we set "no-failover" policy. For Dedicated the runtime and storage remain in the chosen region.

anya-sales: Customer insists: no US sub-processors at all. Can we guarantee that for a Private/Dedicated POC?

sarah-security: Short answer: likely yes for Private — core infra and compute can be EU-only. However some ancillary services (telemetry, crash reporting, analytics) historically used US vendors. We can either: 1) replace with EU vendors, 2) route telemetry to customer's SIEM in EU, or 3) remove those pipelines for the POC. Need legal sign-off.

aaron-legal: We can add an appendix limiting sub-processors to an explicit allow-list. We'll need to know which vendors the customer considers unacceptable. Also need to surface SOC2/GDPR clauses.

oleg-ops: For BYOK/HSM: we support customer-managed keys with HSM-backed keystores and regional KMS endpoints (eu-west-1). On‑prem HSM integration is possible but requires certificate exchange + network setup. Ops effort estimate: 4–6 weeks for full integration.

anya-sales: Pricing ask: what is the rough monthly delta for Dedicated+HSM reserved vs Hosted+BYOK for a POC sized ~100 rps and 1B tokens/month projection?

marta-presales: High level roughing: Hosted+BYOK: base usage pricing + BYOK support fee (~$6k/mo) + egress/ops surcharge. Dedicated+HSM (monthly reserved): baseline dedicated pool $35k/mo + HSM premium $8k/mo + support. These are placeholders; I'll put exact quote once region and retention windows are locked.

tj-eng: Routing policy we recommend for strict residency: tenant_pin with explicit no-failover. Bumping here the example config:
```
routing_policy: {
  mode: "tenant_pin",
  region: "eu-west-1",
  allow_cross_region_failover: false
}
```
Note: autoscale bursts currently can use spare capacity in eu-central-1 if allow_cross_region_failover=true.

sarah-security: Also confirm logs and traces — we can forward audit logs to customer's SIEM in EU via secure transfer. Support engineers' access is sessioned and auditable; we can include that on the appendix. Retention defaults will be respected per agreement.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: #POC-6789 (eu-west-1 private env)

anya-sales: Next steps: - tj to produce filtered sub-processor inventory scoped to EU-only by EOD Tue - oleg to confirm BYOK on‑prem integration runbook + ETA - marta to produce price delta quote w/ assumptions - aaron to draft sub-processor appendix and data residency language. I'll loop in customer once we have the subproc list.

tj-eng: I'll pull the subproc inventory and flag any non-EU vendors. ETA Tue 12:00 CET.

oleg-ops: I'll stub the ops tasks for on-prem HSM + certificate steps and surface networking requirements. ETA 5/12.

marta-presales: Will draft two quotes (Hosted+BYOK, Dedicated+HSM) and attach assumptions & escape clauses. ETA 5/11 COB.

aaron-legal: I'll produce a draft appendix and a short checklist of items we need from the customer (forbidden vendors list, audit requirement, KMS endpoints).

anya-sales: Thanks everyone — will update customer after EOD. :pray:
